usage: project-sandbox [-h] [--version] [--dockerfile DOCKERFILE]
                       [--docker-context DOCKER_CONTEXT] [--python-uv]
                       [--python VERSION] [--rust-cargo] [--rust VERSION]
                       [--node-npm] [--image-tag IMAGE_TAG]
                       [--runtime {auto,apple-container,docker,podman,colima,chroot}]
                       [--colima-profile NAME] [--no-build] [--build-only]
                       [--force-build] [--no-verify-dockerfile]
                       [--memory MEMORY] [--cpus CPUS] [--shm-size SIZE]
                       [--mount EXTRA_MOUNTS]
                       [--vcs-access {full,read-only,hidden}]
                       [--extra-domain EXTRA_DOMAIN] [--allow-github]
                       [--no-firewall] [--build-proxy URL]
                       [--build-no-proxy HOSTS] [--build-ca-cert PATH]
                       [--ca-cert PATH] [--internet-proxy URL]
                       [--no-internet-proxy-preflight]
                       [--egress {firewall,sidecar}] [--sandbox-firewall |
                       --no-sandbox-firewall] [--pi-ollama]
                       [--agent-proxy URL] [--agent-proxy-key-env NAME]
                       [--agent-proxy-key KEY] [--ollama-model MODEL_ID]
                       [--pi-tools TOOLS] [--copilot-host HOST]
                       [--copilot-token-pass ENTRY] [--branch BRANCH]
                       [--branch-start-at REVISION]
                       [--worktree-dir WORKTREE_DIR] [--keep-workspace]
                       [--prompt PROMPT] [--prompt-text PROMPT_TEXT]
                       [--agent {claude,codex,opencode,pi,copilot,bash}]
                       [--log LOG] [--json-summary PATH] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                       [--model MODEL_ID] [--effort LEVEL] [--fast]
                       [--no-forward-credentials] [--api-key-env NAME]
                       [--api-key-env-file FILE] [--no-token-refresh]
                       [--dry-run] [--verbose]
                       project [base_image]

positional arguments:
  project
  base_image

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --dockerfile DOCKERFILE
                        Build the sandbox on top of an existing Dockerfile
                        instead of a base image tag.
  --docker-context DOCKER_CONTEXT
                        Build context to use with --dockerfile (default:
                        project root).
  --python-uv           Synthesise a Python/uv base Dockerfile instead of
                        supplying one. Mutually exclusive with base_image and
                        --dockerfile.
  --python VERSION      Python image tag for --python-uv (default: 3.11). Only
                        valid with --python-uv.
  --rust-cargo          Synthesise a Rust/cargo base Dockerfile instead of
                        supplying one. Mutually exclusive with base_image and
                        --dockerfile.
  --rust VERSION        Rust toolchain version for --rust-cargo, e.g. 1.87,
                        producing rust:1.87-slim (default: latest stable
                        rust:slim). Only valid with --rust-cargo.
  --node-npm            Synthesise a Node.js/npm base Dockerfile with headless
                        Chromium instead of supplying one. Requires
                        package.json and a committed npm lockfile. Mutually
                        exclusive with base_image and --dockerfile.
  --image-tag IMAGE_TAG
  --runtime {auto,apple-container,docker,podman,colima,chroot}
                        Container runtime for direct CLI runs (default: auto).
  --colima-profile NAME
                        Colima profile for --runtime colima (default: project-
                        sandbox). The profile must already be running;
                        project-sandbox never starts or changes it.
  --no-build
  --build-only          Build/warm the sandbox image and exit without starting
                        an agent.
  --force-build
  --no-verify-dockerfile
                        Skip Dockerfile tamper-detection check. Use when you
                        have intentionally edited the Dockerfile and do not
                        want to be prompted. The baseline is still updated
                        after a real build so verification resumes on the next
                        run.
  --memory MEMORY
  --cpus CPUS           CPU limit for the sandbox (default: 4, capped to the
                        CPUs a Docker engine such as a Colima VM has).
  --shm-size SIZE       Shared memory (/dev/shm) size for the container, e.g.
                        2g (default: 2g with --node-npm, otherwise the
                        runtime's default).
  --mount EXTRA_MOUNTS
  --vcs-access {full,read-only,hidden}
                        Runtime access to existing .git/.jj metadata (default:
                        full). Restricted modes keep source files writable.
  --extra-domain EXTRA_DOMAIN
  --allow-github        Allow GitHub and GitHub Copilot hosts at runtime. This
                        includes GitHub's published web/API/git IP ranges and
                        DNS-pinned GitHub Copilot endpoints. Implied by
                        --agent copilot.
  --no-firewall
  --build-proxy URL     Use this credential-free HTTP/HTTPS proxy during image
                        builds only. With Apple container it is reached
                        through a host-loopback forwarder.
  --build-no-proxy HOSTS
                        Additional comma-separated no_proxy entries (hosts,
                        .domains, IPs, CIDRs) during image builds (repeatable;
                        requires --build-proxy).
  --build-ca-cert PATH  Install PEM CAs (single certificate or bundle) before
                        image build downloads (repeatable; trust persists).
  --ca-cert PATH        Install a PEM CA after build commands (repeatable;
                        requires --internet-proxy or --agent-proxy).
  --internet-proxy URL  Route Internet traffic through a credential-free HTTP
                        loopback or remote HTTP/HTTPS proxy (default ports
                        80/443).
  --no-internet-proxy-preflight
                        Skip the host-side reachability check of --internet-
                        proxy, for a proxy that only containers can reach. The
                        sandbox firewall still checks the proxy from inside
                        the sandbox before the session starts.
  --egress {firewall,sidecar}
                        Internet egress mode. 'firewall' (default) pins
                        allowed domains to IPs in the sandbox firewall.
                        'sidecar' routes all traffic through the runtime's
                        global Squid sidecar, which filters by hostname under
                        $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/project-sandbox/egress.toml and is
                        managed with project-sandbox-egress; see docs/egress-
                        sidecar.md.
  --sandbox-firewall    Colima sidecar mode only: also install the sandbox's
                        own firewall, admitting only the sidecar (defense in
                        depth on top of the isolated network).
  --no-sandbox-firewall
                        Colima sidecar mode only: rely on the isolated network
                        alone, with no sandbox firewall or network
                        capabilities (the default once Colima's containment is
                        verified, as it is).
  --pi-ollama           Extend the firewall to reach a host-run Ollama server
                        and pre-configure Pi to use it as the default
                        provider. Only takes effect with --agent pi or
                        --build-only; a no-op otherwise.
  --agent-proxy URL     Route pi, OpenCode, or Bash through an authenticated
                        HTTP loopback or remote HTTP/HTTPS gateway; see
                        docs/agent-proxy.md.
  --agent-proxy-key-env NAME
                        Gateway-key environment fallback (default:
                        AGENTGATEWAY_API_KEY).
  --agent-proxy-key KEY
                        Unsafe last-resort gateway key; shell history and
                        process listings may expose it.
  --ollama-model MODEL_ID
                        Ollama model ID to make available to Pi, overriding
                        the built-in default list. Repeatable; only meaningful
                        with --pi-ollama.
  --pi-tools TOOLS      Comma-separated Pi tool allowlist, e.g. --pi-tools
                        read,grep,find,ls for a read-only session. Only takes
                        effect together with --agent pi; when omitted, Pi's
                        own default tool set applies.
  --copilot-host HOST   GitHub host for --agent copilot: github.com (default;
                        personal, Business, and Enterprise Cloud accounts) or
                        <tenant>.ghe.com (Enterprise Cloud with data
                        residency). Self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server is
                        not supported.
  --copilot-token-pass ENTRY
                        pass entry holding the Copilot token for --agent
                        copilot (default: copilot-github-token, or copilot-
                        github-token/<host> for a GHE.com tenant). An explicit
                        entry never falls back to `gh auth token`.
  --branch BRANCH       Run the agent in a git worktree / jj workspace on this
                        branch (reused if it exists, else created).
  --branch-start-at REVISION
                        Starting commit/tag/branch/bookmark for a NEW branch
                        created by --branch. Errors if the branch/bookmark
                        already exists (delete or merge it first, or omit this
                        flag to reuse it).
  --worktree-dir WORKTREE_DIR
  --keep-workspace      Leave the worktree/workspace in place after the
                        session so a later --branch run on the same branch can
                        reuse it.
  --prompt PROMPT
  --prompt-text PROMPT_TEXT
  --agent {claude,codex,opencode,pi,copilot,bash}
                        Agent to run. When omitted, project-sandbox only
                        initializes generated config files.
  --log LOG
  --json-summary PATH   Write a one-line JSON session summary to PATH after
                        the agent exits; use '-' for stdout.
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --model MODEL_ID      Model ID to use for the agent, in both interactive and
                        unsupervised (batch) runs. Example for Claude: --agent
                        claude --model sonnet --prompt-text '...'. Example for
                        Codex: --agent codex --model gpt-5.4-mini --prompt-
                        text '...'. Example for OpenCode: --agent opencode
                        --model openai/gpt-5.4-mini --prompt-text '...'.
                        Example for Pi: --agent pi --model sonnet --prompt-
                        text '...'. Example for Copilot: --agent copilot
                        --model gpt-5-mini --prompt-text '...'.
  --effort LEVEL        Reasoning effort level for Claude, Codex, OpenCode,
                        Pi, and Copilot, in both interactive and unsupervised
                        (batch) runs. One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
                        project-sandbox does not force a default; when
                        omitted, the underlying agent CLI's own default
                        applies. Examples for Claude: --agent claude --model
                        sonnet --effort low or --agent claude --model sonnet
                        --effort high. Examples for Codex: --agent codex
                        --model gpt-5.4-mini --effort low or --agent codex
                        --model gpt-5.4-mini --effort high. Examples for
                        OpenCode: --agent opencode --model openai/gpt-5.4-mini
                        --effort low or --agent opencode --model
                        openai/gpt-5.4-mini --effort high. Examples for Pi:
                        --agent pi --model anthropic/sonnet --effort low or
                        --agent pi --model anthropic/sonnet --effort high (Pi
                        receives the model unchanged plus a separate
                        --thinking flag). Examples for Copilot: --agent
                        copilot --model gpt-5-mini --effort low or --agent
                        copilot --model gpt-5-mini --effort high (Copilot
                        receives separate --model and --effort flags).
  --fast                Enable the agent's fast mode, in both interactive and
                        unsupervised (batch) runs. Supported for Claude
                        (fastMode setting) and Codex (service_tier = "fast").
                        Fast mode bills at a higher rate and only works with
                        models and plans that offer it. Example: --agent
                        claude --fast or --agent codex --fast.
  --no-forward-credentials
                        Do not stage, mount, or forward host agent credentials
                        (and remove any previously staged), and generate a
                        credential-free devcontainer; start unauthenticated
                        and log in inside the sandbox. Disables the host token
                        refresh and the credential-lifetime warning.
  --api-key-env NAME    With --no-forward-credentials, inject this host
                        environment variable into a direct agent container.
                        Repeat for multiple API keys.
  --api-key-env-file FILE
                        With --no-forward-credentials, inject API key
                        environment variables from a dotenv-style KEY=VALUE
                        file into a direct agent container. Repeat to load
                        multiple files.
  --no-token-refresh    Do not attempt to refresh the host Claude OAuth token
                        before launching, even if it is near expiry. The
                        staged token is used as-is.
  --dry-run
  --verbose
